text: `Stop-Process` 没能结束 MThings，改用 `taskkill` 强制结束。

input.command:
cat > /tmp/free_com4d.ps1 << 'EOF'
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
Write-Host '=== taskkill ==='
cmd /c 'taskkill /F /IM MThings.exe /T'
cmd /c 'taskkill /F /IM mbslave.exe /T'
Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
Write-Host '=== remaining ==='
Get-Process -Name 'MThings','mbslave' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-Table Id, ProcessName, StartTime -AutoSize
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'MThings|mbslave' } | ForEach-Object {
  '{0} pid={1} {2}' -f $_.Name, $_.ProcessId, $_.CommandLine
}
Write-Host '=== open test ==='
try {
  $s = New-Object System.IO.Ports.SerialPort('COM4', 9600)
  $s.Open()
  Write-Host 'PASS: COM4 free'
  $s.Close(); $s.Dispose()
} catch {
  Write-Host ("FAIL: " + $_.Exception.Message)
}
EOF
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File /tmp/free_com4d.ps1
